title: Two-sided partner onboarding checklist and UX copy experiments
content:
Purpose: capture a compact, two-sided onboarding flow for strategic marketplace partners (publishers + sellers) and iterate on short UX copy variants for tiles, trial CTAs, and entitlement language. This is a working doc — lightweight checklist + copy lab for quick A/B ideas we can hand to partnerships and devs for pilot integrations.

Context + scope:
- Audience: ISVs and publisher partners who want a quick go-live on cloud marketplaces (AWS/Azure/GCP) or cloud shelf syndication. Focus on publisher experience (tile, trial, billing link) and seller/merchant governance (SKU mapping, entitlements, trial provisioning).
- Goal: reduce time-to-publish, lower QA fails, and produce 3 ready-to-run copy variants per listing element.
- Not covering deep legal negotiations or full SSO/KMS integration (separate playbook).

Prereqs (tech + legal):
- Confirm SKU mapping doc exists (owner: Solutions Eng) — link JIRA-GTM-1198
- Basic billing contract signed (or sandbox billing token) — finance OK from preflight
- Listing assets: 3 screenshots, 1 hero image 1200x627, 1 short video (optional)
- Security checklist signed-off (SOC2 scope minimal) — security contact: Lena Cho

High-level flow (two-sided):
1) Intake form -> gather partner type (publisher vs seller), target market, preferred cloud shelf, sample pricing
2) Quick validation (GTM PM) -> confirm technical feasibility + SLA tier
3) Sandbox provisioning -> create staging tenant + trial SKU mapping
4) Copy + creative pass -> UX copy lab + screenshots
5) QA run -> smoke tests + metering verification
6) Publish -> soft-launch then full-publication + telemetry checks

Compact acceptance checklist (handy for intake -> publish):
- [ ] Intake completed with contact + partner type
- [ ] SKU mapping draft in repo (PR exists)
- [ ] Billing sandbox token provisioned
- [ ] Images + short description (<= 300 chars)
- [ ] 3 copy variants for tile + 2 CTAs
- [ ] Trial provisioning smoke test green
- [ ] Telemetry events firing (install, trial-start, billing-redirect)
- [ ] Legal flags: export, data residency noted

UX copy experiments (tile headline / 1-line descriptor / CTA variants). Goal: 3 headline variants, 2 CTA styles (action vs reassure). Keep short — 30–90 chars.

Tile headline - variant A (product-first):
- "Low-latency LLM inference for customer-facing apps"
1-line: "Turn user prompts into production responses with predictable latency and cost controls."
CTAs: [Start free trial] / [See pricing details]

Tile headline - variant B (cost-first):
- "Cut token cost with cache-aware serving"
1-line: "Optimize per-token spend while keeping sub-200ms tail latency for interactive features."
CTAs: [Try a sandbox] / [Estimate your savings] (reassuring)

Tile headline - variant C (trust-first):
- "SLA-backed inference for regulated workloads"
1-line: "Private deployments, KMS integrations, and audit logs for enterprise compliance."
CTAs: [Request demo] / [Get enterprise brief] (reassure)

Hero/short description variants (for listing body):
- Variant 1: "Redwood Inference provides a unified runtime for serving LLMs across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments. Ship predictable, low-latency experiences without building infra."
- Variant 2: "Deploy open models with predictable cost: intelligent batching, prefix caching, and model routing with per-route telemetry and rollouts."
- Variant 3: "Bring your compliance needs: private control plane, KMS/HSM integration, and tenant isolation with SLA-backed performance."

Trial provisioning edge cases (notes & acceptance tests):
- Case: partner wants 30-day free trial but requires credit card on file. Action: offer sandbox with restricted quota + optional CC toggle. Test: create trial tenant, attempt usage > quota, verify throttling message and billing redirect link.
- Case: multi-tenant sellers mapping to multiple SKUs. Action: require explicit SKU-to-tenant mapping + docs. Test: simulate two buyers and confirm metering attribution.
- Case: region-limited customers (APAC data residency). Action: tag listing with region availability + fallback notes. Test: deploy trial in ap-southeast region and confirm no cross-region telemetry leaks.

QA matrix (smoke checks to run in staging):
- Listing tile renders correctly (mobile + desktop)
- CTAs route to expected endpoints (trial, demo, pricing)
- Trial provisioning completes within TTL (15m)
- Metering events and billing id captured on first token generated
- Failover policy triggers when capacity constrained (simulate capacity pressure)

Acceptance gates (must be green to publish):
- Creative assets present and copy variants submitted
- Legal sign-off on: privacy, export controls, data residency language
- Security checklist: basic scans + SOC2 statement included in listing copy if relevant
- Billing integration verified in sandbox

Operational handoffs + owners: (quick list)
- Partner intake & case owner: Partnerships (Marco Ruiz)
- Technical onboarding & SKU mapping: Solutions Eng (Priya Nair)
- Security sign-off: Security (Lena Cho)
- Billing verification: Finance Ops (Tom Becker)
- Listing QA + copy finalization: GTM PM (Aisha Patel)

Open questions / TODOs:
- Do we want a single unified CTA for all partners or CTA per partner type? Pros/cons in Slack thread #marketplace-ux (see convo id: slack-5912)
- Need a short privacy blurb template for EU/UK listings — ask legal to provide < 120 char snippet
- Multilingual tile copies — prioritize JA/KO/FR by region usage metrics (ask analytics for traffic matrix)
- Ownership model for marketplace telemetry retention (who maintains dashboards in Console?)

Notes to self / quick reminders:
- Keep hero line < 140 chars for marketplace tiles (some shelves truncate)
- When in doubt, prefer action CTAs for startups, reassurance CTAs for enterprise audiences
- Archive finalized copy variants in repo: /marketplace/copy-lab/ (PR after QA)

Next steps (this week):
- Finalize intake form fields — feed to automation (GTM PM) by EOD Wed (owner: Aisha)
- Run creative pass with partner for pilot (Marco)
- Create sandbox trial flow PR and run QA checklist (Priya + Tom)
- Schedule legal review for privacy snippet (Lena)

Slack threads / refs: slack-5912 (ux-cta debate), slack-6083 (billing sandbox token), CONFLUENCE-6321 (publisher integration spec).

If you’re reviewing: add quick comments inline or drop markers with TODO-<name>. This is intentionally compact so we can ship pilots quickly — we can expand into a full playbook after 2 pilots.

-- Aisha
